titulo: Quiz — Χωρίς and the edited plate
introPt: One salad, one ingredient left out, and a counter that reads the whole plate back.
cenario: A taverna at lunchtime, one table free and a card with twenty lines on it.

dialogo.pt: One village salad, without onion, please.

dialogo.es: Χωρίς κρεμμύδι, εντάξει. Ντομάτα, αγγούρι, φέτα — όλα τα άλλα μέσα;
dialogo.pt: Without onion, fine. Tomato, cucumber, feta — everything else in?
dialogo.tts: Χωρίς κρεμμύδι, εντάξει. Ντομάτα, αγγούρι, φέτα — όλα τα άλλα μέσα;

dialogo.es: Ναι, όλα. Και με πολύ λεμόνι.
dialogo.pt: Yes, everything. And with plenty of lemon.
dialogo.tts: Ναι, όλα. Και με πολύ λεμόνι.

dialogo.es: Ωραία. Θέλετε να δείτε τι έχουμε σήμερα; Ελάτε.
dialogo.pt: Good. Would you like to see what we have today? Come.
dialogo.tts: Ωραία. Θέλετε να δείτε τι έχουμε σήμερα; Ελάτε.

opcoes: In front of the dish
At the end, after the dish, with nothing in front of it changing
Only in the middle of a full sentence
It cannot be used at a counter
perguntas.explica: One word at the end, then the thing you do not want. The order in front of it stays exactly as it was.

perguntas.pergunta: The counter reads the whole plate back to you as a question. You should:
opcoes: Start the order again from the beginning
Listen to the end and answer ναι, or take out one more thing
Assume the first request was not heard
Point at the card instead
perguntas.explica: The read-back is your last window to edit. The first χωρίς already landed.

perguntas.pergunta: Something in the dish would genuinely make you ill. Χωρίς is:
opcoes: Enough on its own
Not the right tool — that has its own sentence and its own written card
Only usable with a doctor's note
Stronger than any other option
perguntas.explica: Χωρίς is preference. The heavier sentence and the written card are a separate part of the course, deliberately.

perguntas.pergunta: How does a table of small plates usually get built?
opcoes: All at once, at the start
In waves, with ένα ακόμα doing the work as you go
From a set menu chosen by the kitchen
One plate per person, ordered separately
perguntas.explica: Nobody commits to the whole evening at the moment of sitting down. Ένα ακόμα is the sentence that keeps it moving.

perguntas.pergunta: You cannot read the card and the food is in trays behind the counter. Μπορώ να δω; is:
opcoes: A phrase you may use — in many places asking to look is acceptable
A guaranteed right to inspect the kitchen
Considered an accusation about hygiene
Only for markets, never for a taverna
perguntas.explica: What this course stands behind is the sentence, not a claim about how any given kitchen is run. If the answer is no, the card is the route and the question cost nothing.
